name: Quinto – El Piquete church
story: The old parish church of the Assumption, called 'El Piquete', stands on the Cerro de la Corona above Quinto. In August 1937 about 300 Nationalist defenders turned it into a fortress, and civilians also took refuge inside. The XV International Brigade and other Republican units took it after bitter house-to-house fighting and artillery fire, and the western face of the tower was heavily damaged. The fighting destroyed most of the town, which was rebuilt after the war by the Francoist regions-devastated agency.
see: The battle-scarred church on its hill. Inside, restoration uncovered 18th-century mummified burials ('las momias de Quinto'), now displayed there.
plan: Visits are run by Quinto council, so check times locally. Combine it with the Purburel trenches.
